title: HB1599 (2020 Regular Session): Modifies the offense of unlawful use of a weapon to apply to the open or concealed carrying of a firearm in the City of St. Louis without a concealed carry permit.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.030 (RSMo): (11) Possesses a firearm while also knowingly in possession of a controlled substance that is sufficient for a felony violation of section 579.015; or
Section 571.030 (RSMo): (12) Within any city not within a county, carries openly or concealed upon or about his or her person a firearm.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): 4. Subdivisions (1), (8), (10), and (12) of subsection 1 of this section shall not apply to any person who has a valid concealed carry permit issued pursuant to sections 571.101 to 571.121, a valid concealed carry endorsement issued before August 28, 2013, or a valid permit or endorsement to carry concealed firearms issued by another state or political subdivision of another state.
Section 571.030 (RSMo): (5) Subdivision (12) of subsection 1 of this section shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor for the first offense and a class E felony for a second or subsequent offense.
